dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Visible concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a falcate profile from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Obtuse rounded morphology with a measurable pixel radius at the fin's maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior slope at approximately 45 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.0; base width is roughly equivalent to the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curvature of the melon region with a moderate arc radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum extension with low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse interior angle where the melon slope meets the rostrum's dorsal boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity cyan/teal false-color rendering or luminance across the entire epidermal surface.
